get.description: Local only. Paired devices (token hashes are never returned).

put.description: Remote listener and relay tunnel only. Requires a paired device bearer token with either view or decide scope.

delete.description: Remote listener and relay tunnel only. Requires a paired device bearer token with either view or decide scope.
Local only. Revokes a device immediately: later requests get 401 and its open event WebSockets close.

patch.description: Local only. Update enabled, push, or scope (view or decide); at least one field is required. Muting push preserves API/event access. Scope changes apply immediately. Disabled devices get 403 and their event WebSockets close with code 4403.

400.description: Invalid or empty body; submit scope cannot be changed

101.description: WebSocket events: {type, request} for request.created (carrying the final status, so auto-handled requests arrive already decided), request.decided, request.expired and request.cancelled; request.updated when a pending request's desktop run starts or its claim is released (`request.run`); {type: yolo.changed, yolo} when YOLO mode changes or its timer ends. Closed immediately when the calling device is revoked (4401) or disabled (4403)

get.description: Resolved requests, newest resolution first, with cursor pagination. history.keep_days/max_requests and best-effort history.max_bytes bound retained requests; history.files_keep_days can expire files while keeping history.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: approved, denied, expired, cancelled, or auto (rule or YOLO decision)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only requests with a preview of this type

parameters.name: has
parameters.description: attachments: any file, files, image, pdf, audio, or video preview

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Request kind: command, edit, review, question, or custom

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search in title, summary, and cwd

post.description: Local only (unix socket or loopback bearer). Issues a one-time pairing code for `handup pair`. With `relay: true`, opens a fresh relay channel and returns a relay pairing link that carries the channel, the device's relay credential, the daemon's Noise public key, and the code.

409.description: Remote access (or the relay) is off or has no reachable base URL

502.description: The relay refused or could not be reached

post.description: Remote listener only. Trades a one-time pairing code for a device token. Rate-limited per peer IP; every attempt counts.
Send a fixed synthetic approval or question to try the inbox. Missing body or kind defaults to approval; no client-supplied request content is accepted.

403.description: Remote device without decide scope or submit token

get.description: Audit events of one request, oldest first (created, decided, expired, cancelled), with the deciding device's name when it is still paired.

200.description: Claimed: `run` is set and no other decision, expiry, or timeout applies until the desktop app reports the result, the request is cancelled, or the lease lapses
Run claim dropped (the command never started)
Local only: metadata, never secrets or hashes

201.description: Local only: new submit secret (shown once) and integration metadata

400.description: Invalid name, expiry, or duplicate name

200.description: UI policy: undo window, primary action side, HTML network access, remote mode/warning, relay pairing, calling device

get.summary: Build of the running daemon, so clients and `handup doctor` can spot a daemon left over from an older install.

200.description: Local only: daemon version and commit

get.description: YOLO mode: off, on (auto-approve new low and medium risk requests) or hard (every risk). Runtime only; a daemon restart turns it off.

put.description: Set YOLO mode, optionally `for` a duration after which it turns off. Applies to requests created afterwards; matching rules still win and requests that need a human answer (questions, fields, feedback policies, several approve options) stay pending. Emits `yolo.changed`.

Answer.description: The human's answer to one question.

selected.description: Chosen option labels; at most one unless the question is `multi`.

text.description: Typed answer; only when the question allows free text.

device_name.description: Name of the paired device when `actor` is `device:<id>` and that device is still paired.

oneOf.description:
The desktop app ran the request's command for the human: this is how
it ended. Present only on approved command requests decided by Run.

DecisionFields.description:
Decision `fields`. Question requests carry only `answers`, keyed by question
id; other requests carry answers to `input.fields` or edited tool input.

Device.description:
A paired remote device. The bearer token itself is never stored; only its
SHA-256 digest is (see `remote::hash_token`).

scope.description: `view` (read-only) or `decide` (adds decision, cancel and test requests).

Email.description:
An email draft for review. handup never sends it: on approval the agent
sends the draft (or the edited `decision.fields`) with its own mail tool.

date.description: Date shown in the header, as the agent formats it (e.g. RFC 2822).

body.description: Message body as Markdown (plain text renders as-is).

body_html.description: Optional HTML alternative; rendered only in the sandboxed HTML preview frame.

oneOf.description: The message this draft replies to, shown collapsed under the body.

blob.description: Uploaded blob hash (`POST /v1/blobs`) so the reviewer can open the file.

body.description: Plain text of the earlier message (or a snippet of it).

History.description:
Retention for resolved requests (decision history). The daemon prunes at
start and hourly; 0 disables a cap. Pending requests are never pruned.

keep_days.description: Delete resolved requests older than this many days (0 = no age cap).

max_requests.description: Keep at most this many resolved requests (0 = no count cap).

max_bytes.description: Best-effort live database/WAL/blob byte cap, excluding free database pages (0 = unlimited).

files_keep_days.description: Remove files belonging only to resolutions older than N days (0 = request lifetime).

resolved_at.description: Unix milliseconds when the request left `pending`.

HistoryOutcome.description:
How a resolved request ended, as history shows it. `auto` is a rule or
YOLO-mode decision; `expired` includes timeouts that auto-approved (`on_timeout: approve`).

IntegrationToken.description: Named submission credential. Secrets and digests are never serialized.

code.description: One-time code (single use, expires after 2 minutes).

url.description: Pairing page URL; the code travels in the fragment so it never reaches server logs.

fingerprint.description: TLS leaf certificate SHA-256 fingerprint when the remote listener uses TLS.

PairCreate.description: Local-only: create a pairing request (body for `POST /v1/pair`).

name.description: Device name; the pairing page may suggest one when empty.

relay.description:
Pair through the end-to-end encrypted relay (`remote.relay.url`)
instead of the remote listener.

cookie.description: Browser flow: set `HttpOnly` session cookies instead of returning the token.

token.description: Long-lived device token (`hu_` + 64 hex). Omitted in the cookie flow.

host.description:
This computer's name (its hostname), so a device paired with several
computers can tell them apart. Absent when unknown.

Question.description: A question for the human; answered in `decision.fields.answers[id]`.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the request.

allow_free_text.description: Allow a typed answer besides (or instead of) the options.

label.description: Answer text; unique within its question and returned in `selected`.

description.description: One-line explanation shown under the label.

preview.description: Markdown shown while the option is focused (code blocks allowed).

callback_url.description: Terminal-event destination; requires the daemon callbacks.allowlist.

timeout.description: Optional positive duration, at most one year. Absent uses config; null/`none` disables expiry.

oneOf.description: Present while the desktop app runs the command (daemon-managed).

RequestInput.description:
Request `input`. Only `kind: question` requests interpret `questions`;
other keys (for example raw agent tool input) pass through unchanged.

fields.description: Generic form fields (`text`, `textarea`, `select`, `boolean`) for non-question requests.

questions.description: Structured questions (1..=10) for `kind: question`; answers arrive in `decision.fields.answers`.

RunClaim.description:
The handup desktop app on this computer is running the request's command
right now. While the claim holds, the request stays pending but no other
decision, expiry, or timeout applies; cancelling it stops the run. Set and
cleared only by the daemon.

started_at.description: Unix milliseconds when the run was claimed.

lease_until.description:
Unix milliseconds after which an unreported run no longer holds the
request (the app crashed or lost the daemon).

RunResult.description:
Outcome of running a command request in the handup desktop app. The
command already ran: an agent must not run it again. Output is the
redacted tail of each stream.

exit_code.description: Process exit status; absent when it never started or a signal ended it.

stdout_tail.description: Last bytes of standard output (at most 64 KiB), credentials redacted.

stderr_tail.description: Last bytes of standard error (at most 64 KiB), credentials redacted.

duration_ms.description: Wall time from start to exit, in milliseconds.

truncated.description: Earlier output was dropped from either tail.

elevated.description: Ran with administrator rights (pkexec on Linux, osascript on macOS).

error.description:
Why it did not finish normally: timeout, cancellation, signal, or a
start failure (for example pkexec missing or authentication refused).

content_hash.description: Content hash the window showed; the claim fails if the request changed.

integration.description: Server-verified integration token name; caller values are overwritten.

session_title.description: Display-only session name; scoped rules always use the session ID.

UiSettings.description: Read-only UI policy derived from daemon config; never includes secrets.

primary_side.description:
`decisions.primary_side`: right or left, the edge of decision footers
that holds the primary (approve) action. Apps may override it per device.

remote_warning.description: Direct-mode risk warning; UIs show it as a persistent banner when set.

pair_relay.description:
`remote.relay.url` is set, so local callers can pair through the relay
(`POST /v1/pair {relay: true}`). Always false for paired devices.

oneOf.description: The calling paired device on the remote listener; null for local callers.

for.description: Optional duration (`15m`, `1h`); absent = until turned off. Not valid with `off`.

until.description: Unix milliseconds when the mode turns itself off; null = until turned off.
